about: Zenkai Rules Z1 intent examples for PAR-hollow-pass's outcome check (night-1 triage rank 2, scratchpad/night1-parity-install-guide-triage.md, row 488), corrected by Pratik's ruling (row 496 item 5) and review fix round 2 (finding 1/D-1): a HAPPY variant where both sides fail the same way is needs_review always -- the verb never ran. An ERROR variant is the harness deliberately breaking the call, so both sides refusing the SAME typed way is exactly the point and a genuine pass; it becomes needs_review only when a side ACCEPTED the bad input instead of refusing it, or the shared code is transient. Gated behind policy flag parity.same_failure_is_pass (tests/gauntlet/data/check_map.json's flags list, a Zenkai Z4 override record), default off. Run by gauntlet/tests/test_evaluate.py (evaluate()'s own gate, given a reason) and tests/intent/test_parity_needs_review_intent.py (the REAL parity_pair computing that reason, per finding 11 -- oracle B is a fixture verdict list, not a re-implementation of the formula).
subject: tests/gauntlet/exec_parity.py parity_pair/_parity_needs_review; gauntlet/evaluate.py evaluate() + Policy.flags/KNOWN_FLAGS

examples.source: Pratik's ruling row 496 item 5: 'both-sides-fail-the-same is needs_review, never pass, for HAPPY variants'
Pratik's ruling row 496 item 5: 'an ERROR variant passes when both sides refuse identically'; review D-1 blocker: the old rule scored ALL 46 error variants (12 P0) needs_review, which this fixes
Pratik's ruling row 496 item 5: '[an error variant] becomes needs_review only when a side accepted the bad input' (finding 1, the triage's PAR-error-variant-accepted class)

brief: 'implement it behind a flag parity.same_failure_is_pass defaulting to false so a one-line config flip restores the old scoring'; parity.same_failure_is_pass stays per fix round 2's instructions
